name: Miguel Santo Domingo (Brujah antitribu, Pack Priest of the Navigators)

system.concept: Pack priest of the nomadic Navigators, suspicious that his sire DeSoto conceals a dark secret
system.title: Pack Priest, the Navigators
system.biography:
Background

Santiago DeSoto Embraced Miguel Santo Domingo, a small-time bandit, in 1920s Brazil, recognizing a kindred buccaneer spirit. Miguel became pack priest of the nomadic Navigators — a floating pack that raids @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} enclaves along the Great Lakes and Saint Lawrence Seaway from their lair-ship, the Lisbon — when DeSoto joined the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Inquisition in 1969. DeSoto's abrupt retirement into seclusion after the trial of Archbishop Sangris has only deepened Miguel's suspicion that his sire hides some dark secret; in truth, "DeSoto" is now the resting place of Sangris' own soul, and Miguel is unknowingly correct.

Roleplaying Hints

Direct and straightforward, devious only when necessary, open among your pack and friends. You ride your frenzy with pleasure when destroying the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s enemies.
system.notes: Embraced 1924. Apparent age: early 30s. @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.MkHKLOcOCLQ5pWCj]{Path of Honorable Accord} 8. Disciplines (as printed): Celerity 3, Fortitude 2, Potence 4, Presence 3.

system.description:
Facetiously named, this power allows the Kindred to physically knock another character away from herself with the slightest of touches. Although this power does no damage in and of itself, its use is quite humbling — to be hurled away from an elder in a social setting has its embarrassing repercussions. Some Kindred use this power surreptitiously, touching their victims and sending them reeling across the room; others use it as a not-so-subtle display of their might, giving their victim a casual slap with overwhelming results.

System: The player spends a Blood Trait and must succeed in a physical challenge to touch the target (this may be done surreptitiously, but the player may not make use of other Potence benefits). The challenge is not required if the subject allows the player to touch him (a handshake, a “friendly” hand on the shoulder, etc). This power hurls the victim 20 feet directly away from the invoking character. If the subject strikes a wall or other solid obstacle, he suffers two health levels of bashing damage. Otherwise, the character needs to win a static physical challenge against six Traits to remain standing.

A Brujah with this power can stir the hearts of his allies, granting them courage and strength for the cause they fight for. Once employed, those affected fight fearlessly and with great strength, following the Cainite into battle against even overwhelming odds.

System: The player rolls Strength + Intimidation (difficulty 7). Any opposing power meant to inspire fear or otherwise prevent an affected ally from fighting suffers +2 difficulty. All affected allies — mortal, ghoul, or Cainite — also gain one dot of Potence for the scene per two successes. The number of successes determines how many allies are affected, from a single person (1 success) up to every ally in the vampire's immediate vicinity, such as a courtyard or battle group (5 successes).
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Three: Zealots

system.description: By spending a Blood Trait, you gain a further additional action at the end of the turn, on top of any gained from Swiftness.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

items.name: Presence — 2 Intermediate — Command the Wary Steed

system.description:
Through use of this power the Cainite can cause enemies' mounts to rear and bolt, singly or en masse, by the strength of his gaze alone, or bolster the courage and tractability of allied steeds for greater control in battle.

System: The player spends a Willpower point and rolls Manipulation + Animal Ken (difficulty 7). Enemy mounts become terrified and nigh uncontrollable: Ride roll difficulties increase by three and mounted combat becomes impossible. Friendly mounts become far more pliant (-2 difficulty on all Ride rolls) and may be coerced into situations they would normally avoid.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Three: Zealots

system.description: You gain one additional health level, functioning as an extra Healthy level on your health chart, which can be lost and healed normally.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
